_help: Photo inventory, the single source for all scripts. Paths relative to photos/. Every photo is stored in reading direction (sheets the right way up, puzzle with the text readable at the bottom). 'origin' = file name as it came out of the phone.

sheets._help: Each photo is a VIEW of all or part of a sheet. SAME PROCESS FOR EVERY SHEET: every photo declared here is measured and fused (src/fusion.py); the most recent one of a piece gives the orientation of the piece on its sheet (proposed rotations). Naming: <sheet>[_colXX-YY]_<date>[_<time>].jpg (time only if a sheet has several photos the same day). columns = [first, last] sheet column visible; rows = number of rows. Number of a piece = row × 10 + column (grid of 10 for every sheet; E: E001–E010 then E011–E012 below E001–E002). If the photo shows ANOTHER layout (former layout of the sheet), 'number_grid' gives the number of each position of the photo, row by row. zone_x / zone_y (fractions of width / height): area of the pieces of the sheet; pieces out of the zone (another sheet in the frame) are ignored. Scale: computed automatically, recalibrated on the pieces seen on other photos (corrects a photo taken at an angle); no value to enter. contour: 'mid_level' (whole sheet, glare filled) or 'top_surface' (close-up photo: cardboard edge excluded).

sheets._rejected_note: The 64 Mpx sheet photos of 2026-11-20 (IMG_20261120_103242 / 103311 / 103329 / 104253 / 103355) were measured and fused on 2026-11-20 and not kept: side lighting (bright cardboard rim on one side, cast shadow on the other) biases their outlines asymmetrically; whole-outline agreement with the other photos 0.9–1.2 u vs 0.65–0.72 u between the 18th and 19th; adding them gave no gain on the engine sigma, the cells with >= 2 sides or the piece<->piece pairs (mutual pairs 340 -> 324, strong 22 -> 11).

board._help: The reference defines the numbering of the cells L(line)-C(column), counted from the top-left corner of the puzzle in reading direction.
board._reference_note: The 64 Mpx board photo of 2026-11-20 (IMG_20261120_104350) was tried as the reference and rejected: camera shake (edges across the board's x axis 2.0 u wide vs 1.5 u), sockets worse (best match p90 3.8 u vs 2.2 u, 63 sockets > 2.5 u vs 12). Not kept.
